name: denubis-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for Python/SQL/LaTeX development workflows - customized for academic research

plugins.name: denubis-00-getting-started
plugins.description: Getting started guide and onboarding for denubis-plugins

plugins.name: denubis-plan-and-execute
plugins.description: Planning and execution workflows for Claude Code. Slow and steady.

plugins.name: denubis-basic-agents
plugins.description: Core agents for general-purpose tasks with Python/academic domain variants. Other plugins expect this to exist.

plugins.name: denubis-research-agents
plugins.description: Agents for codebase investigation and internet research.

plugins.name: denubis-extending-claude
plugins.description: Knowledge skills for extending Claude Code: creating plugins, agents, skills, maintaining CLAUDE.md, and syncing with upstream

plugins.name: denubis-hook-skill-reinforcement
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that directs the model to consider and activate useful skills.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-claudemd-reminder
plugins.description: PostToolUse hook that reminds to invoke project-claude-librarian before committing when git status or git log reveals changes that may warrant CLAUDE.md updates.

plugins.name: denubis-git-commit
plugins.description: Git commit skill for Claude Code. Handles /commit as a proper skill.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-gh-fork-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that blocks gh CLI commands targeting any repo other than the user's fork. Auto-discovered by the pretooluse-bash dispatcher.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-pretooluse-dispatcher
plugins.description: PreToolUse:Bash dispatcher with auto-discovery from marketplace plugins and drop directory. Runs hooks sequentially and merges outputs.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-branch-bg
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that sets terminal background colour based on git repo (hue) and branch (hue/lightness/saturation offsets) via OSC 11. Uses git-common-dir so worktrees share a colour family.

plugins.name: denubis-bibliography
plugins.description: Render PDFs from a Zotero corpus to per-page markdown for engagement; emit page-keyed blockquotes with pandoc-style citations; annotate cited passages back into the Zotero PDF as highlights. WIP — documents only the workflow proven end-to-end so far.

plugins.name: denubis-crash-recovery
plugins.description: Identify and resume Claude Code sessions that ended abnormally; classifies live/crashed/concluded sessions deterministically and renders ~/llm-resume.md.

plugins.name: denubis-token-estimator
plugins.description: Measure AI token/word usage from Claude Code and Codex logs for AI-use disclosures. Output tokens (origin-deduplicated, main thread vs subagent fan-out) and human-authored input words (machine wrappers stripped), per project, rolled up from the directory via a .token-estimator mapper, optionally by month. WIP — methodology established and reproducible; external audit pending.

plugins.name: denubis-external-agents
plugins.description: Dispatch work to a mind that is not this session, as a heterogeneous second voice: external CLI models and other-model advisors alike. Run OpenAI's codex as a critical peer reviewer at whatever model your codex config selects, spawn a different-model advisor in a pane that is structurally unable to implement, or supervise a codex pane through the prompt-file loop and its event monitor. Review paths carry a mandatory provenance check so a confabulated review cannot pass as real. WIP.
